MainAttr_Str.Name: Titan's Apotheosis
MainAttr_Str.Lore: You train as though every task were a stone to be lifted, making strength the foundation of your whole bearing.
MainAttr_Dex.Name: Quicksilver Incarnate
MainAttr_Dex.Lore: Balance, breath, and movement flow together like quicksilver, carrying your discipline beyond the blade.
MainAttr_Con.Name: Adamantine Vessel
MainAttr_Con.Lore: Years of hardship have taught your body to meet every ordeal with the patience of tempered metal.
MainAttr_Int.Name: Architect of Self
MainAttr_Int.Lore: You study your own habits like an arcane diagram, turning careful understanding into practiced control.
MainAttr_Wis.Name: Ocular of the Cosmos
MainAttr_Wis.Lore: Following the ideal of self-perfection associated with Irori, you make quiet attention the center of your practice.
MainAttr_Cha.Name: Sovereign of Wills
MainAttr_Cha.Lore: Your confidence gathers scattered effort into a single purpose, as a sovereign gathers a wavering court.
WeaponInsight_Str.Name: Titan's Momentum
WeaponInsight_Str.Lore: Rather than chase delicate openings, you commit your weight to a weapon's path and trust its momentum.
WeaponInsight_Dex.Name: Aldori Finesse
WeaponInsight_Dex.Lore: Inspired by Aldori dueling traditions, you guide the blade with balance and exacting footwork.
WeaponInsight_Con.Name: Stout Grounding
WeaponInsight_Con.Lore: A steady breath and a planted stance keep your weapon true even when fatigue begins to bite.
WeaponInsight_Int.Name: Geometer's Edge
WeaponInsight_Int.Lore: You see the duel as intersecting lines, choosing each stroke by angle rather than impulse.
WeaponInsight_Wis.Name: Karmic Interception
WeaponInsight_Wis.Lore: You watch the intention behind a motion and meet your opponent where their next step will lead.
WeaponInsight_Cha.Name: Swashbuckler's Flourish
WeaponInsight_Cha.Lore: A flourish invites the eye to follow one story while your weapon pursues another.
Extended_InnerSentinel.Name: Ascetic's Ward
Extended_InnerSentinel.Lore: Lightly burdened, you guard yourself through a traveler's quiet awareness and measured movement.
Extended_CalculatedGrip.Name: Anatomical Leverage
Extended_CalculatedGrip.Lore: Anatomy turns a grapple into a study of joints, leverage, and the direction of resistance.
Extended_UnyieldingWill.Name: Monarch's Stature
Extended_UnyieldingWill.Lore: You hold your ground with the bearing of someone who expects to be obeyed.
Extended_BrutalDefender.Name: Titan's Footing
Extended_BrutalDefender.Lore: Strong legs and a deliberate stance let you answer force without surrendering your footing.
Extended_LightfootDefense.Name: Zephyr's Grace
Extended_LightfootDefense.Lore: With little armor to hamper you, every small shift of weight becomes part of your guard.
Extended_IronEndurance.Name: Adamantine Mettle
Extended_IronEndurance.Lore: You have learned to carry hardship in your flesh as a forge carries the day's heat.
Defensive_Str.Name: Colossus Bastion
Defensive_Str.Lore: You brace like a fortress buttress, letting practiced strength support your whole defense.
Defensive_Dex.Name: Wind-Dancer's Shroud
Defensive_Dex.Lore: You borrow the rhythm of a swaying reed, keeping your guard in motion rather than fixing it in place.
Defensive_Con.Name: Inured Carapace
Defensive_Con.Lore: Old scars remind you how to endure a blow and keep your composure under strain.
Defensive_Int.Name: Analytical Aegis
Defensive_Int.Lore: You read the angle of an approaching strike and place your guard where it will matter.
Defensive_Wis.Name: Third Eye Vigil
Defensive_Wis.Lore: Patient attention catches small changes in a foe's bearing before they become a committed attack.
Defensive_Cha.Name: Majesty's Reproach
Defensive_Cha.Lore: Your unyielding bearing turns defense into a contest of resolve as much as steel.
Maneuver_Str.Name: Grip of the Behemoth
Maneuver_Str.Lore: You bring the weight of a great beast to every grip, push, and struggle for position.
Maneuver_Dex.Name: Fulcrum of the Viper
Maneuver_Dex.Lore: A small turn at the right pivot can redirect more force than a head-on struggle.
Maneuver_Con.Name: Deep-Root Clinch
Maneuver_Con.Lore: Endurance lets you maintain a hold after the first contest of strength has passed.
Maneuver_Int.Name: Anatomical Pivot
Maneuver_Int.Lore: You study how joints move together and use that knowledge to guide a maneuver.
Maneuver_Wis.Name: Crane's Anticipation
Maneuver_Wis.Lore: You feel an opponent's balance through contact, answering their movement with your own.
Maneuver_Cha.Name: Audacious Overthrow
Maneuver_Cha.Lore: An assertive step and a forceful challenge lend conviction to your attempt to unseat a foe.
Skilled_Str.Name: Giantwright's Craft
Skilled_Str.Lore: Work that tires others teaches you the discipline of applying strength with care.
Skilled_Dex.Name: Thief-King's Panache
Skilled_Dex.Lore: Your hands learn each task as a rhythm, returning to its fine motions with a performer's ease.
Skilled_Con.Name: Ascetic Diligence
Skilled_Con.Lore: Where inspiration fades, patient repetition keeps your craft moving forward.
Skilled_Int.Name: Encyclopedic Synthesis
Skilled_Int.Lore: You connect unfamiliar problems to knowledge already gathered, building bridges between disciplines.
Skilled_Wis.Name: Wanderer's Lucidity
Skilled_Wis.Lore: Travel and observation have taught you to hear what a task requires before reaching for a tool.
Skilled_Cha.Name: Silver-Tongued Virtuoso
Skilled_Cha.Lore: Confidence carries your performance through unfamiliar work, inviting others to believe in your command.
Arcane_Str.Name: Mage-Hammer Inscription
Arcane_Str.Lore: You approach an incantation as a smith approaches iron, shaping it with disciplined exertion.
Arcane_Dex.Name: Somatic Velocity
Arcane_Dex.Lore: Exact, practiced gestures give your spellwork the cadence of a deft duelist.
Arcane_Con.Name: Crucible of the Conduit
Arcane_Con.Lore: You make bodily endurance part of your magical practice, learning to bear the effort of channeling power.
Arcane_Int.Name: Archmage's Codex
Arcane_Int.Lore: Every spell becomes a proposition to study, refine, and set beside the work of earlier arcanists.
Arcane_Wis.Name: Gnostic Channel
Arcane_Wis.Lore: You listen for the cadence beneath an incantation and let attentive instinct guide its expression.
Arcane_Cha.Name: Sovereign Decrees
Arcane_Cha.Lore: You speak an incantation with the confidence of a decree, giving its form the weight of conviction.
Stance_Str.Name: Berserker's Overrun
Stance_Str.Lore: You commit to the next blow with a battle zeal reminiscent of Gorum, leaving less attention for your guard.
Stance_Dex.Name: Willow in the Gale
Stance_Dex.Lore: Like a willow in a gale, you favor yielding movement over the force of a committed strike.
Stance_Con.Name: Mountain's Deep Roots
Stance_Con.Lore: You settle into a mountain's patient stillness, gathering yourself at the cost of offensive tempo.
Stance_Int.Name: Grandmaster's Gambit
Stance_Int.Lore: You study the openings left by passing foes, keeping a careful account of their movement.
Stance_Wis.Name: Mirror of Still Waters
Stance_Wis.Lore: You quiet the impulse to strike, accepting a gentler attack in exchange for a steadier guard.
Stance_Cha.Name: Vanguard's Banner
Stance_Cha.Lore: You place your companions' courage before your own safety and become the standard they rally around.
Conditional_EndlessResolve.Name: Defiance at the Precipice
Conditional_EndlessResolve.Lore: When injury narrows your choices, you answer with the stubborn patience of a cornered animal.
Conditional_FirstBlood.Name: Ambush of the Viper
Conditional_FirstBlood.Lore: You practice the opening exchange until the first heartbeat of a fight feels familiar.
Conditional_Vendetta.Name: Oath of Retribution
Conditional_Vendetta.Lore: A companion's death gives grief a direction, lending fierce purpose to the strokes that follow.
Conditional_PatientHunter.Name: Crane's Severance
Conditional_PatientHunter.Lore: You reserve your fullest commitment for the first clean opportunity of each exchange.
Conditional_BerserkersLastStand.Name: Gorum's Last Stand
Conditional_BerserkersLastStand.Lore: At the edge of defeat, you trade caution for a final display of the Iron Lord's battle fervor.
Conditional_TacticalReading.Name: Cadence Decoded
Conditional_TacticalReading.Lore: One exchange gives you a pattern to study, letting later attacks follow a better-informed line.
Derived_ArcaneAegis.Name: Arcane Aegis
Derived_ArcaneAegis.Lore: Years of spellwork teach you to turn practiced magical control toward personal defense.
Derived_MartialInsight.Name: War-Hardened Reflexes
Derived_MartialInsight.Lore: Battle has trained your responses until endurance, movement, and resolve share the same rhythm.
Derived_SkilledDefender.Name: Scholar's Positioning
Derived_SkilledDefender.Lore: Lessons gathered from many crafts become practical answers to an enemy's approach.
Derived_MysticVitality.Name: Ley-Infused Vitality
Derived_MysticVitality.Lore: You make the discipline of channeling magic part of the discipline of sustaining yourself.
Derived_SoulBulwark.Name: Dawn of the Soul
Derived_SoulBulwark.Lore: When battle begins, your practiced spellwork gathers around you like a brief mantle of dawn.
Derived_SwordSaint.Name: Blade of the Spell-Saint
Derived_SwordSaint.Lore: The precision learned with a weapon gives you another way to shape demanding magic.
Summon_BloodlineOfBeasts.Name: Behemoth's Heritage
Summon_BloodlineOfBeasts.Lore: You lend your summoned companions the forceful bearing that guides your own movements.
Summon_QuickenedPact.Name: Zephyr's Covenant
Summon_QuickenedPact.Lore: The rhythm of your agile steps becomes a pattern for the creatures answering your call.
Summon_VitalPact.Name: Titan's Lifespring
Summon_VitalPact.Lore: You draw on your own hardiness when preparing a body for a summoned companion.
Summon_TacticalBinding.Name: Aegis of the Schema
Summon_TacticalBinding.Lore: You plan a summoned creature's defenses as carefully as an architect plans a wall.
Summon_InsightfulSummons.Name: Empathic Communion
Summon_InsightfulSummons.Lore: Attentive guidance helps a summoned companion meet danger with steadier instincts.
Summon_MagneticCalling.Name: Dominator's Calling
Summon_MagneticCalling.Lore: Your confident command gives summoned companions a clear purpose when they enter the fray.
SummonerSacrifice_BodyOfMyPact.Name: Martyr's Transference
SummonerSacrifice_BodyOfMyPact.Lore: You accept a body's burden so that the creatures bound to your call may stand stronger.
SummonerSacrifice_DoubledBond.Name: Eldritch Crucible
SummonerSacrifice_DoubledBond.Lore: An exacting pact magnifies what you surrender, letting sacrifice feed a companion's strength.
SummonerSacrifice_EmpoweredSacrifice.Lor: You yield some commanding presence to give a summoned body greater physical force.
DistanceDamage_AggressorsEdge.Name: Point-Blank Ruin
DistanceDamage_AggressorsEdge.Lore: You train to deliver a committed blow in the cramped space inside an opponent's guard.
DistanceDamage_MarksmansFocus.Name: Horizon's Deadeye
DistanceDamage_MarksmansFocus.Lore: Distance gives you room to read a target's line and settle the weapon before release.
DistanceDamage_OptimalRange.Name: Harmonic Cleave
DistanceDamage_OptimalRange.Lore: You study the middle ground of an engagement, where spacing lets a weapon do its best work.
SpellTag_School_PureWarder.Name: Aegis of the Pure Warder
SpellTag_School_PureWarder.Lore: You approach abjuration with patient attention, choosing its wards over other branches of magic.
SpellTag_School_MasterCaller.Name: Sovereign Gatekeeper
SpellTag_School_MasterCaller.Lore: Your magic finds its clearest voice at the threshold between a call and an answer.
SpellTag_School_SeersEdge.Name: Eye of the Chronomancer
SpellTag_School_SeersEdge.Lore: You compare signs and patterns until divination feels like reading a carefully kept record.
SpellTag_School_HeartsTyrant.Name: Sovereign of the Heart
SpellTag_School_HeartsTyrant.Lore: You study how conviction and desire give enchantment a foothold in another mind.
SpellTag_School_Spellforge.Name: Pyre of the Architect
SpellTag_School_Spellforge.Lore: You favor the direct expression of energy, shaping evocation with an architect's deliberate design.
SpellTag_School_Veilweaver.Name: Phantasmagoria Maestro
SpellTag_School_Veilweaver.Lore: Light, expectation, and careful presentation become the instruments of your illusion craft.
SpellTag_School_DeathSpeaker.Name: Harvester of the Boneyard
SpellTag_School_DeathSpeaker.Lore: You study mortality's thresholds; the Boneyard is an image for that inquiry, not a claim of Pharasma's approval.
SpellTag_School_ShapeShifter.Name: Sculptor of Prime Matter
SpellTag_School_ShapeShifter.Lore: You consider every material form a structure whose relationships can be understood and rearranged.
SpellTag_Descriptor_InnerFlame.Name: Pyre of the Phoenix
SpellTag_Descriptor_InnerFlame.Lore: You give fire magic the fierce expression of your own conviction, borrowing the phoenix as its image.
SpellTag_Descriptor_FrozenHeart.Name: Stillness of the Glacial Void
SpellTag_Descriptor_FrozenHeart.Lore: Still attention lends your cold magic the patient character of a glacier.
SpellTag_Descriptor_StormChannel.Name: Tempest-Dancer
SpellTag_Descriptor_StormChannel.Lore: Your practiced gestures trace the paths by which lightning takes shape.
SpellTag_Descriptor_EtchingMind.Name: Vitriolic Equation
SpellTag_Descriptor_EtchingMind.Lore: You bring an alchemist's attention to acid magic, considering how each surface yields to corrosion.
SpellTag_Descriptor_ResonantVoice.Name: Herald of the Shattered Sky
SpellTag_Descriptor_ResonantVoice.Lore: You shape sonic magic with the same conviction that carries your voice across a hall.
SpellTag_Descriptor_EthericMind.Name: Axiom of Unseen Force
SpellTag_Descriptor_EthericMind.Lore: You picture invisible force as an exact arrangement of pressures and boundaries.
SpellTag_Descriptor_RadiantSoul.Name: Fountain of Solar Dawn
SpellTag_Descriptor_RadiantSoul.Lore: The image of first light gives your positive-energy magic a clear and generous expression.
SpellTag_Descriptor_HollowHeart.Name: Vigil of the Gloom
SpellTag_Descriptor_HollowHeart.Lore: You contemplate endings until negative-energy magic finds a restrained, deliberate form.
SpellTag_Descriptor_SubtleTyrant.Name: Puppeteer of the Mind
SpellTag_Descriptor_SubtleTyrant.Lore: You study the threads of attention through which mind-affecting magic takes hold.
ReactiveArmor_SpikedDefense.Name: Barbed Carapace
ReactiveArmor_SpikedDefense.Lore: You imagine armor as a thorned carapace, turning the idea of a close assault back upon its source.
ReactiveArmor_BulwarkOfSteel.Name: Citadel of Steel
ReactiveArmor_BulwarkOfSteel.Lore: Layered armor becomes the image of a portable fortress, built to endure one exchange at a time.
PolearmMaster.Name: Long-Reach Gambit
PolearmMaster.Lore: You commit to a wider arc of engagement, accepting a less forceful blow as the price of distance.

WeaponDamage_Strength.Name: Strength to Weapon Damage
WeaponDamage_Strength.Description: Choose a weapon category in which you are proficient. Replace mode (default): Use your Strength modifier instead of the weapon's existing damage attribute when this improves damage. The normal weapon damage multiplier is preserved, including two-handed and off-hand use. Add mode: Add your positive Strength modifier once to normal weapon damage. This extra bonus is not multiplied or halved for two-handed or off-hand use. Only applies to attacks with the chosen category that already use an attribute modifier for damage. Weapons without a damage attribute (such as ordinary crossbows) gain no benefit. Does not change attack rolls, spell damage, or other statistics. Does not require Power Mode. You can take this feat again for a different weapon category. When mutual exclusivity is enabled, you can select only one attribute within this family. Choose the active mode in the Weapon Damage setting. Changes apply on the next damage calculation, without restarting or reselecting the feat.

If the EnableBAB power option is on, it also adds half the modifier to Base Attack Bonus; with Power Mode on, half the modifier to attack, damage, attacks of opportunity, sneak attack, hit points and speed, plus 1 foot of reach. Restrictions: While the Main Attribute Mastery exclusion group is on, a character can have only one Main Attribute Mastery feat.
Text.MainAbilityToEverything_Feats.Build: Main Attribute Mastery (retired) · {0} {1} {2} Effect: Adds half your {0} modifier (minimum 0, rounded down; the full modifier in Legacy_AllFull) to your other five ability scores as an inherent bonus, when attribute bonuses are enabled in mod settings. If self-stacking is enabled it also adds to {0}. Retired: This feat is no longer offered. Characters that already have it keep it. Text.CastingStatFeats.Create.desc: Casting Attribute · {0} Effect: Choose one of your spellbooks. It uses {0} as its casting attribute: spell save DCs, bonus spell slots, the minimum score needed to cast each spell level, and concentration all use it. Settings: Casting Scope can make the feat apply to all your spellbooks instead; Casting Mode can make it apply only when {0} is higher than the spellbook's own attribute. Restrictions: Each spellbook can have only one casting attribute feat. You can take the feat again for another spellbook.
Adds half your caster level as an untyped bonus to AC.
Text.DerivedStatFeats.CreateMartialInsig: Adds half your base attack bonus as an untyped bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws.
Text.DerivedStatFeats.CreateSkilledDefen: Adds one third of your total skill ranks as an untyped bonus to AC.
Text.DerivedStatFeats.CreateMysticVitali: Adds your caster level as an untyped bonus to Hit Points.
Caster Level to Temporary Hit Points
At the start of combat, gain temporary hit points equal to your caster level for up to 10 minutes or until combat ends, whichever comes first.
Text.DerivedStatFeats.CreateSwordSaint.T: Base Attack Bonus to Spell DC
Adds half your base attack bonus as an untyped bonus to the save DC of your spells. Class and racial abilities are not affected.
Derived_SoulBulwark.Temp.Desc: Derived · Caster Level to Temporary Hit Points A reserve of radiant psychic force gathers around your soul for up to 10 minutes or until combat ends, whichever comes first, absorbing damage before your mortal flesh yields.
Derived_SoulBulwark.Buff.Desc: Derived · Caster Level to Temporary Hit Points The soul keeps its own vigil, calling protective strength into place whenever a fight begins.
Text.DerivedStatFeats.BuildDescription.D: Derived · {0} {1} Effect: {2} Restrictions: None. This feat is independent and stacks normally with other feat families.
Text.ResourceStatFeats.Create.desc: Resource Attribute · {0} Effect: Choose one of your resources whose uses grow with an ability modifier, such as channel energy, ki, lay on hands, performance rounds, or bloodline and domain powers. Its bonus uses come from your {0} modifier instead. The new maximum applies the next time the resource is restored, for example after resting. Restrictions: Each resource can have only one resource attribute feat. You can take the feat again for another resource.

Applies only while wearing no armor or light armor. This feat can be combined with other Extended Replacement feats.
Adds your Intelligence modifier as an untyped bonus to CMB.
This feat can be combined with other Extended Replacement feats.
Adds your Charisma modifier as an untyped bonus to CMD.
Adds your Strength modifier as an untyped bonus to CMD.
Adds your Dexterity modifier as an untyped bonus to AC while wearing no armor or light armor.
Adds your Constitution modifier as an untyped bonus to Hit Points.
Text.StatReplacementFeats.BuildWeaponIns: Weapon Insight · {0} {1} Effect: Your weapon attack rolls use your {0} modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity whenever {0} would be better. Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Weapon Insight feat.

Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text: You treat an enemy's swing not as an assault to weather, but as an open invitation to strike.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.2: When an adversary's strike cuts empty air, you slip past their recovered guard before they can reset their stance.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.3: A blow aimed at you leaves a vivid trace in your mind, guiding your weapon back toward its author with cold purpose.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.4: You read the subtle tremor along an opponent's guard at the moment of deflection, guiding your reply into their exposed core.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.5: You lean your entire bulk into the friction of combat, ensuring every clash sends the opponent staggering backward.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.6: Your flesh meets incoming weapons like cold iron, shuddering hard enough under impact to splinter the hands that strike you.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.7: You weather blows like the armored hide of a deep-sea horror, sloughing off crippling afflictions as the pain crests.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.8: Each felled foe frees your motion rather than slows it, pulling you eagerly toward the next engagement.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.9: You treat a melee as a continuous melody of strikes, sharpening your edge with every hit so long as your defense remains unsullied.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.10: By fixing your gaze entirely upon a single opponent, you read their evasions in real time and weave extra strikes into their blind spots.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.11: You structure your attacks like verse, building steady pressure until the fourth beat breaks the defense entirely.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.12: You know how to strike where flesh has already torn, widening an existing agony into a fatal collapse.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.13: When your own blood spills, you channel the searing burn of mortal distress into a furnace that engulfs everything near you.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.14: You strike not merely against armor, but against the vital momentum that keeps towering monsters upright.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.15: Your first engagements aim to shatter an opponent's pristine vigor before they have settled into the rhythm of the duel.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.16: You shape your spells to unravel the underlying weave that binds an immense creature's vital essence together.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.17: With tooth and claw, you draw upon the ancient law of the hunt, devouring an adversary's vitality to renew your own.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.18: You align your weapon strokes to draw vigor from spilled life, turning every successful cut into renewed stamina.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.19: As a foe's breath departs, you gather the unraveling magical filaments of their dying consciousness to rekindle your own reserves.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.20: With your deeper spell slots preserved intact, your simplest cantrips inherit the radiant pressure of an overflowing mind.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.21: You weave incantations so cleanly that stray echoes of power fold back into your mental repertoire rather than dispersing into the air.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.22: You hone your weapon to disrupt the subtle concentration of spellcasters, sundering their memory of spells with each ringing blow.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.23: You direct your magic to pierce an opponent's prepared reservoir, turning the strain of their expended intellect into a concussive rupture.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.24: In the confusion born of a sudden, brutal wound, you dissolve into the periphery of sight before onlookers can locate your blade.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.25: Having trained without companions to shield your flanks, your vigilance sharpens only when the ground around you is clear.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.26: Through hundreds of life-or-death skirmishes, your muscles absorb the evasive reflexes of every agile prey you run down.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.27: Walking beside heaps of fallen enemies thickens your sinews and bones, packing your frame with stubborn, brutal mass.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.28: By dissecting the final patterns of dying arcanists, you piece together new insights that expand the architecture of your thought.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.29: Each life cut short before you leaves a flicker of vital warmth that settles into your marrow, steadily fortifying your survival.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.30: You bind the vengeful remnants of slain foes to your wake, compelling their restless sorrow to sharpen your next blow.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.31: You interweave your vital humors with the conjured forms at your side, letting restorative medicine mend you as one organism.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.32: Understanding that long steel demands wide arcs, you practice burying compact blades into tight crevices where polearms falter.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.33: You crowd inside your opponent's ideal guard, turning what should be a lack of weapon reach into an oppressive, suffocating press.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.34: You bypass abstract scholastic formulas, tearing spell formulas into reality through sheer bodily exertion and vocal thunder.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.35: Your somatic components mimic the blinding precision of a master embroiderer, threading magical currents through agile fingertips.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.36: You treat your own bloodstream and lungs as the crucible for magic, anchoring spells to the unyielding stamina of your flesh.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.37: You draw deep upon your physical bulk, converting sheer muscular mass into an endurance that outlasts lesser bodies.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.38: You preserve energy through frictionless movement, allowing balance and reflex to fuel your special techniques without fatigue.
Text.FeatLore.Labels.Text.39: Your vitality runs deep into your bones, ensuring that moments requiring extraordinary resolve never find you emptied.
ReactiveArmor_BulwarkOfSteelBuff.Desc: Reactive Armor · Living Fortress Citadel of Steel is active, granting temporary hit points each round equal to your current armor bonus.
Text.ReactiveArmorFeats.BuildSpikedDefen: Reactive Armor · Retaliation {0} Effect: While wearing armor, whenever a foe hits you with a melee weapon attack, that attacker takes 1d6 + your armor bonus as untyped damage. Restrictions: Requires armor to function. While its exclusion group is on, you can have only one Reactive Armor feat.
Text.ReactiveArmorFeats.BuildBulwarkOfSt: Reactive Armor · Sustained Guard {0} Effect: While wearing medium or heavy armor, you refresh temporary hit points each round equal to your current armor bonus. Restrictions: Requires medium or heavy armor to function. While its exclusion group is on, you can have only one Reactive Armor feat.
When an enemy makes a melee attack against you, you make an attack of opportunity against it if it is within your reach. This uses one of your attacks of opportunity for the round, so Combat Reflexes increases how often you can counter.
Once per round, when an enemy's melee attack misses you, you make an attack against it if it is within your reach. This counterattack does not use your attacks of opportunity.
This creature attacked someone with the Blood-Debt Reckoning feat this round.
Against enemies that attacked you this round, you gain +1 on attack and damage rolls per 4 character levels (minimum +1, maximum +5).
Your next attack is a confirmed critical hit.
After you successfully parry an attack, your next attack within 2 rounds is an automatically confirmed critical hit.
After each of your weapon attacks and after each weapon attack against you, hit or miss, you attempt a bull rush against that enemy. This bull rush does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Text.RetaliationFeats.ConfigureReturnDam: Whenever an enemy damages you with a melee or ranged attack or a spell, it takes damage equal to half your character level plus your Strength modifier (minimum 1).
You gain DR 1/— plus 1 per 4 character levels. After you take damage totalling a tenth of your maximum hit points, all harmful effects on you are removed and the count resets.
Text.SurvivalFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.2: You cannot die and keep acting at negative hit points. When this ends, you die if your hit points are still at or below the negative of your Constitution score.
Text.SurvivalFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.4: When damage reduces you to 0 hit points or fewer, you become Undying for 1 hour: you cannot die and keep acting at negative hit points. If you are not healed above the death threshold (negative Constitution score) before it ends, you die. It can trigger again after it ends.
Text.ModMenuSettings.Register.Text.7: Truly Solo: pets in the party reduce the count
Text.ModMenuSettings.Register.Text.5: Limit Homebrew feat points per character
Text.ModMenuSettings.Register.Text.3: Limit the number of Homebrew feats per character
Text.ArcanaFeats.ConfigureArcana.Text.3: Once per round, when an enemy you damaged dies, regain one spent spell slot of a level no higher than half that enemy's Hit Dice (minimum 1).
Text.ArcanaFeats.ConfigureArcana.Text.5: Your cantrips deal extra damage equal to the total spell levels of your unspent spell slots divided by 5.
Text.ArcanaFeats.ConfigureArcana.Text.7: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher from a spellbook, there is a 15% chance the spell slot is restored.
Text.ArcanaFeats.ConfigureArcana.Text.9: When your weapon hits a spellcaster, it loses its highest unspent spell slot and takes extra damage equal to twice that slot's level. Once per round.
Text.ArcanaFeats.ConfigureArcana.Text.11: When your spell damages a spellcaster, it loses its highest unspent spell slot and takes extra damage equal to twice that slot's level. Once per round.
Your mind-affecting, charm, compulsion and emotion effects ignore immunity to those effects (for example, undead and constructs).
Your death effects ignore immunity to death effects.
Your fear effects ignore immunity to fear.
Your poison and disease effects ignore immunity to poison and disease.
Your paralysis, stun, daze and sleep effects ignore immunity to those effects.
Creatures immune to an energy type take half damage from your damage of that type instead, and are never healed by it.
Text.SpellTagFeats.BuildSchoolDescriptio: Spell Tag · School Specialist · {0} · {1} {2} Effect: When their corresponding mod settings are enabled, adds half your {1} modifier (rounded down, minimum 0, untyped) to matching {0} spell and ability save DC and caster level, while all other schools take an equal penalty. Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Spell Tag School Specialist feat, but can stack with Descriptor Specialist feats. Your mastery comes at a price — DC and caster level of all other schools suffer an equal penalty.
Text.SpellTagFeats.BuildDescriptorDescri: Spell Tag · Descriptor Specialist · {0} · {1} {2} Effect: When their corresponding mod settings are enabled, adds half your {1} modifier (rounded down, minimum 0, untyped) to save DC and caster level for spells and abilities with the {0} descriptor group. Subtracts the same amount for EACH other matching group ({3}). Bonuses and penalties combine on spells and abilities with multiple matching groups. Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Spell Tag Descriptor Specialist feat, but can stack with School Specialist feats. Your mastery comes at a price — DC and caster level of {3} spells and abilities suffer an equal penalty.
Text.ConditionalFeats.NewBuff.Text: {0} Attribute modifiers used for bonuses and matching penalties have a minimum of 0.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateEndlessResol: Defiance at the Precipice is active, adding your Constitution modifier as an untyped bonus to AC and Fortitude saves.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateFirstBloodBu: Ambush of the Viper is active, adding your Dexterity modifier as an untyped bonus to attack rolls and automatically confirming your critical threats.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateVendettaBuff: Oath of Retribution is active, adding your Charisma modifier as an untyped bonus to attack rolls and damage for 3 rounds.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreatePatientHunte: Crane's Severance is active, adding twice your Wisdom modifier as an untyped bonus to damage on your first weapon attack each combat round; it is consumed even if that attack misses.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateBerserkersLa: Gorum's Last Stand is active, adding your Strength modifier as an untyped bonus to attack rolls and damage while applying an equal untyped penalty to AC.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateTacticalRead: Cadence Decoded grants your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) as an untyped attack bonus for up to 10 minutes. Combat beginning or ending removes it; attacks do not refresh an active buff.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateEndlessResol: While you are below half health, gain a buff that adds your Constitution modifier as an untyped bonus to AC and Fortitude saves.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateFirstBlood.T: During the first round of combat, gain a 1-round buff that adds your Dexterity modifier as an untyped bonus to attack rolls and automatically confirms your critical threats.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateVendetta.Tex: When an ally within 30 meters dies, gain a 3-round buff that adds your Charisma modifier as an untyped bonus to attack rolls and damage.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreatePatientHunte: At combat start and at the start of each round, gain twice your Wisdom modifier (minimum 0) as an untyped damage bonus for your first weapon attack. It is consumed whether that attack hits or misses.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateBerserkersLa: While you are below 25% health, gain a buff that adds your Strength modifier as an untyped bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage, and applies an untyped penalty to AC equal to your Strength modifier.
Text.ConditionalFeats.CreateTacticalRead: After a weapon attack resolves, gain your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) as an untyped attack bonus for up to 10 minutes if this buff is absent. Combat beginning or ending removes it; attacks do not refresh an active buff.
Text.ConditionalFeats.BuildConditionalDe: Conditional · {0} {1} Effect: {2} Attribute modifiers used for these bonuses and matching penalties have a minimum of 0. Restrictions: None. This feat is independent and stacks with other feats.
Text.DistanceDamageFeats.ConfigureAll.ef: Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus of up to +4 that depends on how close you are when you hit. Measured from your centre to the target's edge, the bonus is +4 when pressed against the target and drops by 1 for every 1.5 feet. Smaller creatures can stand closer and so reach the higher values.
Text.DistanceDamageFeats.ConfigureAll.Te: Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus by weapon type: +4 with light weapons, unarmed strikes and natural attacks; +3 with one-handed weapons; +2 with two-handed weapons; no bonus with reach weapons.
Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus by your total reach with that weapon (your own reach plus the weapon's): +4 at 5 feet, +2 at 10 feet, and no bonus at 15 feet or more.
Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus by weapon type: +4 with reach weapons, +2 with other two-handed weapons, none otherwise.
Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus by your total reach with that weapon: none at 5 feet, +2 at 10 feet, +4 at 15 feet or more.
Ranged and thrown weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus by the weapon's range: +4 at 50 feet or more, +3 at 40 feet, +2 at 30 feet, +1 at 20 feet.
Ranged and thrown weapon attacks gain a +4 untyped damage bonus while no enemy is engaging you in melee.
Text.DistanceDamageFeats.ConfigureAll.ef: Ranged and thrown weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus of +1 for every full 10 feet beyond 10 feet to the target, up to +4.

Melee weapon attacks gain an untyped damage bonus of up to +4 that grows with the distance to the target when you hit: +1 for every 1.5 feet between you and the target's edge, reaching +4 at the edge of a reach weapon's range.
DistanceDamage.Buff.Name: Distance Damage
DistanceDamage.Buff.Desc: Distance Damage is active, granting a +4 untyped bonus to damage for the current weapon attack.
Text.DistanceDamageFeats.CreateCloseQuar: Distance Damage · {0} Effect: {1} Stacking: Stacks with the other feats of the same distance style (up to +12 together).
Text.DistanceDamageFeats.BuildDescriptio: Distance Damage · {0} {1} Effect: {2} Restrictions: Feats within one distance style stack; feats from different styles exclude each other.
Text.ExecutionFeats.ConfigureExecution.T: For every 10% of hit points the target is missing (up to 90%), your weapon attacks deal +1 damage plus 1 per 10 character levels.

At the start of each round in combat, enemies within 15 feet take fire damage equal to half your character level (minimum 1), increased by the percentage of hit points you are missing (for example, +50% when you are at half health).
Your weapon hits deal extra damage equal to 2% of the target's maximum hit points (minimum 1, at most three times your character level).
Your weapon hits deal extra damage equal to 3% of the target's current hit points (minimum 1, at most three times your character level).
When your spell damages an enemy, it takes extra damage equal to 2% of its maximum hit points (minimum 1, at most three times your character level). Once per target for each spell you cast.
Your natural attacks deal extra damage equal to 2% of the target's maximum hit points (minimum 1, at most three times your character level), and you heal the same amount.
You heal 15% of the damage your weapon attacks deal.
Text.MomentumFeats.ConfigureKillsAndRhyt: +2 on attack rolls and +10 feet speed per stack (up to 3 stacks).
When your weapon attack drops an enemy, gain a Cascading Carnage stack until the end of your next turn: +2 on attack rolls and +10 feet speed per stack, up to 3 stacks.
+1 on attack rolls and +2 damage per stack (up to 3 stacks).
Each weapon hit you land adds an Unbroken Measure stack for 3 rounds: +1 on attack rolls and +2 damage per stack, up to 3 stacks. Each weapon hit you take removes one stack.
FervorBuff.Name: Quarry's Obsession
FervorBuff.Desc: +1 dodge AC per stack; at 3 stacks, one extra attack in a full attack.
FervorAttackBuff.Name: Quarry's Obsession: extra attack
FervorAttackBuff.Desc: One extra attack in a full attack.
Text.MomentumFeats.ConfigureFervorAndCri: Each consecutive weapon attack against the same target, hit or miss, adds an Obsession stack (up to 3): +1 dodge AC per stack, and at 3 stacks you make one extra attack in a full attack. Attacking a different target resets the stacks.
Every fourth weapon attack you make, hit or miss, is an automatic critical threat that is automatically confirmed if it hits.
Text.PolearmMasterFeats.BuildDescription: Polearm Master · Reach Tradeoff {0} Effect: Doubles your reach. You take a -4 untyped penalty to weapon damage. Restrictions: Works with any weapon category; no polearm requirement is implemented. This is an independent feat.
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.2: While active, adds your Strength modifier (minimum 0, untyped) to attack rolls and damage. You suffer a penalty equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 0) to AC.
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.4: While active, adds your Dexterity modifier (minimum 0, untyped) to AC and Reflex saves. You suffer a penalty equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum 0) to attack rolls.
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.6: On activation, gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 0); this stance does not refresh them each round. Your attack rolls and Attack of Opportunity count are reduced by your Constitution modifier (minimum 0).
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.8: While active, attacks of opportunity and their count gain an untyped bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier, minimum 0. Other attack rolls take an equal penalty.
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.10: While active, adds your Wisdom modifier (minimum 0, untyped) to AC and Will saves. Attack rolls and damage take an equal penalty; this stance does not reduce initiative.
Text.StanceFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.12: While active, other allies within 30 feet gain an untyped bonus to attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 0). You suffer a penalty equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 0) to AC.
Stance_Cha.AllyBuff.Desc: Stance · Charisma The Warlord's Standard. Your ally fights under the inspiring canopy of your sovereign courage. Effect: Grants an untyped bonus to attack rolls equal to the user's Charisma modifier (minimum 0) while within 30 feet.
Text.StanceFeats.BuildDescription.Descri: Stance · {0} {1} {2} Effect: {3} Activation: Free action to toggle. The Stance exclusion group limits learning to one Stance feat. With it off, multiple learned stances can be toggled on together; there is no separate activation limit. Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Stance feat.
Text.WeaponPenetrationFeats.ConfigureAll: Your critical hits apply even to creatures immune to critical hits.
Your sneak attacks and other precision damage apply even to creatures immune to precision damage.
Text.GrowthFeats.ConfigureKillGrowth.Tex: Every 100 enemies you kill permanently increase your Dexterity by 1. There is no limit.
Every 100 enemies killed by your party (including pets) permanently increase your Strength by 1. There is no limit.
Every 10 spellcasting enemies you kill permanently increase your Intelligence by 1. There is no limit.
Every 10 enemies you kill permanently increase your maximum hit points by 1. There is no limit.
NecromasteryBuff.Name: Souls
Text.GrowthFeats.ConfigureNecromastery.T: Each enemy you kill grants a soul, up to twice your character level (and never more than 40). You deal +1 damage per 2 souls. Souls persist until you die.
Text.MemeFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.3: When your weapon attack drops an enemy or scores a critical hit, you say "Man, what can I say." At most once per round. No other effect.
NobodyKnowsBetter.Name: Nobody Knows It Better
Text.MemeFeats.ConfigureAll.Text.4: Choose a skill. You gain +2 on it, and whenever you use it you announce that nobody knows it better than you (at most once per round).
Text.SoloFeats.ConfigureSolo.Text.2: No ally is within 30 feet: dodge bonus to AC, bonus on saving throws and damage of +1 per 4 character levels (minimum +1).
Text.SoloFeats.ConfigureSolo.Text.4: While no conscious ally is within 30 feet of you, you gain a dodge bonus to AC and a bonus on saving throws and damage rolls equal to +1 per 4 character levels (minimum +1). Summoned creatures and pets count as allies. Checked each round.
Text.SoloFeats.ConfigureSolo.Text.6: Per absent companion: +1 to all ability scores, dodge AC, saving throws, attack and damage.
Text.SoloFeats.ConfigureSolo.Text.7: For each companion who has joined you but is not in your party (up to 5), you gain +1 to all ability scores, dodge AC, saving throws, attack and damage. Companions who have not joined yet do not count. A setting decides whether pets in the party reduce the count.
Vanishing Stroke has triggered this round.
Once per round, when your weapon attack drops an enemy, scores a critical hit, or deals sneak attack damage, you become greatly invisible for 1 round.
Your summoned creatures gain an untyped bonus to Strength equal to your Strength modifier.
Your summoned creatures gain untyped bonuses to Dexterity and Speed equal to your Dexterity modifier.
Your summoned creatures gain an untyped bonus to Constitution equal to your Constitution modifier.
Your summoned creatures gain an untyped bonus to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier.
Your summoned creatures gain untyped bonuses to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saves equal to your Wisdom modifier.
Your summoned creatures gain an untyped bonus to attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier.
Text.GreaterSummoningFeats.BuildDescript: Greater Summoning · {0} {1} Effect: {2} Attribute modifiers used for these bonuses and matching penalties have a minimum of 0. Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Greater Summoning feat.
Text.SummonerFeats.ConfigureSummoner.Tex: Whenever you summon creatures, you summon one additional creature per 3 caster levels (minimum 1). This applies to every summoning spell or ability you use, including those from other mods.
Creatures you summon remain for 24 hours longer than normal.

Whenever you are healed, your summoned creatures within 30 feet heal the same amount. Whenever one of your summoned creatures is healed, you heal half that amount. Healing shared by this link is never shared again, so it does not bounce back and forth.
Text.SummonerSacrificeFeats.ConfigureAll: You take a -4 untyped penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. Your summoned creatures gain a +4 untyped bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.
You take a -2 untyped penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. Your summoned creatures gain a +4 untyped bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.
You take a -4 untyped penalty to Charisma. Your summoned creatures gain a +8 untyped bonus to Strength.
Text.SummonerSacrificeFeats.BuildDescrip: Summoner Sacrifice · {0} {1} Effect: {2} Restrictions: While its exclusion group is on (configurable in mod settings), you can have only one Summoner Sacrifice feat.
FeatGroup.SameAttribute: Same attribute across Main, Adept and Stance
FeatGroup.DistanceStyle: One distance style (close, mid or long range)
ACHomebrewSelection_ManeuverTactics.Name: Maneuver Tactics
ACHomebrewSelection_ManeuverTactics.Desc: Choose one feat. Each choice grants only the selected feat. You can return to this selection whenever you gain another feat; each feat's normal prerequisites and mutual-exclusion rules still apply.
SeizeOpening.Name: Seize the Opening
LingeringDisruption.Name: Lingering Disruption
SeizeOpening.Desc: A moment's hesitation is all the invitation you need. Each round in combat, perform one eligible combat maneuver as a free action. You also have three extra free uses per encounter, allowing a second free maneuver that round. At most two maneuvers per round become free; further uses keep their normal action cost. Failed attempts count, canceled actions do not. Resources, range, targeting and other requirements still apply. These limits can be configured.
LingeringDisruption.Desc: They regain their footing, but never quite their composure. Timed effects of your successful combat maneuvers last twice as long, gaining at least two rounds: 1 round becomes 3, 2 become 4, and 3 become 6. Applies to disarm, sunder armor, dirty tricks and supported effects from other mods. It does not prolong prone, displacement or permanent effects. Reapplication follows the effect's normal stacking rules. The multiplier and minimum extension can be configured.
Text.ManeuverSettings.Title: Maneuver Tactics
ACHomebrewSelection_Duel.Name: Duel
ACHomebrewSelection_Duel.Description: Choose one feat. Each choice grants only the selected feat. You can return to this selection whenever you gain another feat; each feat's normal prerequisites and mutual-exclusion rules still apply.
DuelVictories.Name: Duel Victories
DuelVictories.Desc: +1 damage with weapon attacks for each duel won.
DuelBuff.Name: Dueling
DuelBuff.Desc: Can attack only the opponent, and damage dealt to anyone else is prevented. Unless protected by Unbound Duelist, compelled to attack the opponent and cannot act otherwise. Ends after 2 rounds or when either duelist falls.
DuelAbility.Name: Duel
DuelAbility.Desc: Standard action, supernatural. Challenge a conscious enemy within close range that is not dueling. For 2 rounds, you and it can attack only each other, damage either of you deals to anyone else is prevented, and each duelist is compelled to attack the other unless it has Unbound Duelist. The duel ends early when either duelist falls. If your opponent falls unconscious or dies while you remain standing, you win and permanently gain +1 damage with weapon attacks; if you fall, your opponent gains it. Once per encounter.
DuelOath.Name: Oath of the Duel
DuelOath.Desc: You name your foe, and the rest of the battle falls away. You gain the supernatural ability Duel. As a standard action, choose a conscious enemy within close range that is not dueling. For 2 rounds, you and it are compelled to attack only each other: neither can cast spells, use items or act otherwise, and damage either deals to anyone else is prevented. Use it 1 time per day plus 1 per 5 character levels, at most once per encounter. The duel ends early when either duelist falls. If your opponent falls unconscious or dies during the duel while you remain standing, you win and permanently gain +1 damage with weapon attacks, without limit. If you fall, your opponent gains it instead; if both fall together, nobody wins. Your Cavalier's Challenge (including Knight's Challenge) also counts as a duel without spending Duel: when the challenged foe falls while the challenge lasts, you win, and if you fall first, it wins. A challenge does not compel either side and is settled once. Victories are kept until you respec.
EndlessChallenge.Name: Endless Challenge
EndlessChallenge.Desc: Each victory only sharpens your appetite for the next rival. You can use Duel 2 more times per day. Duel remains limited to once per encounter.
SingleCombat.Name: Single Combat
SingleCombat.Desc: While your eyes are on your rival, interlopers barely register. While you are dueling, through Duel or a challenge that counts as a duel, damage you take from anyone other than your opponent is halved.
MythicDuelOath.Name: Unbound Duelist
MythicDuelOath.Lore: The duel binds your blade, but no longer your will.
MythicDuelOath.Effect: Requires Oath of the Duel. Your duels no longer compel you: you keep full control and can still cast spells, use items and help yourself or your allies, but you can attack and target hostile effects only at your opponent, and damage you deal to anyone else is still prevented. Your opponent remains compelled to attack only you.
Duel.Restriction.Caster: Already dueling, or Duel was already used in this encounter
Duel.Restriction.Target: Target a conscious enemy that is not dueling
FingerOfTheReaper.Name: Finger of the Reaper
FingerOfTheReaper.Desc: Every soul your word unmakes lends weight to the next. Your Finger of Death deals +1 damage per caster level. Each creature it kills permanently adds +1 more, without limit. A creature counts when it dies and your Finger of Death dealt the final, lethal damage; each death counts once, so a creature raised and slain again counts again. Works with Finger of Death from any source, including scrolls and wands. Kills are kept in your save and reset if you lose this feat, for example by respec.
